messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The LSTM network in the model architecture is a type of artificial neural network that uses sequential information and maintains history through its intermediate layers." -- cites: E1 (Section abstract): quote "3.1 Bidirectional LSTM with Attention Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is a class of artificial neural networks which utilizes sequential information and maintains history through its intermediate layers."
2. "The LSTM network is used in the model architecture as part of a hybrid approach to clickbait detection." -- cites: E2 (Section abstract): quote "We first explain the three individual components followed by their fusion, which is our proposed model. These components are (1) BiLSTM with attention, (2) Siamese Network on Text Embeddings,"

Cited evidence:
[E1] (text, Section abstract, page 2): We now go into detail about the components of the model, individual and combined, and how the parameters are learned. 3.1 Bidirectional LSTM with Attention Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is a class of artiﬁcial neural networks which utilizes sequential information and maintains history through its intermediate layers. A standard RNN has an internal state whose output at every time-step which can be expressed in terms of that of previous time-steps. However, it has been seen that standard RNNs suffer from a problem of vanishing gradients [ 9 ]. This means it will not be able to efﬁciently model dependencies and interactions between words that are a few steps apart. LSTMs are able to tackle this issue by their use of gating mechanisms. We ﬁrst explain the three individual components followed by their fusion, which is our proposed model. These components are (1) BiLSTM with attention, (2) Siamese Network on Text Embeddings,

verdicts.reason: The cited evidence in E1 (Section abstract) states that '3.1 Bidirectional LSTM with Attention Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is a class of artificial neural networks which utilizes sequential information and maintains history through its intermediate layers.' This directly supports the claim that the LSTM network in the model architecture is a type of artificial neural network that uses sequential information and maintains history through its intermediate layers.

The cited evidence in E2 (Section abstract) only mentions 'BiLSTM with attention' as one of the three individual components of the hybrid approach to clickbait detection. It does not explicitly state that the LSTM network is used in the model architecture as part of a hybrid approach to clickbait detection. The claim goes beyond the evidence provided.
